clarifications: Task scope is strictly 5 budget-counted files.
Normal G-031 limit of 5 files is observed with zero overrides.
G-041 semantic authorization is FALSE (zero semantic files modified).
G-042 guardrails authorization is FALSE (zero guardrails modified).
Representation uses primitive boolean isStunned: boolean without introducing CharacterControlState, NORMAL, UNSTUNNED, NOT_STUNNED, StunStatus, or any closed Control State vocabulary.
Preferred API is doesStunBlockFiring(isStunned: boolean): boolean.
Required behavior: isStunned === true => STUN blocks firing => return true; isStunned === false => STUN itself does not block firing => return false.

Critical authority boundary: A result of false MUST mean only: 'STUN itself does not block firing'. It MUST NOT mean the character is actionable, globally eligible to fire, all control restrictions are absent, all firing prerequisites are satisfied, canFire is true, Weapon Action becomes FIRING, or firing begins.

No combined positive predicate (such as doPostureAndControlSatisfyFiringPrerequisites) is implemented; existing posture-side prerequisite query and new STUN-specific blocker remain separate narrow facts.
Runtime validation throwing TypeError on non-boolean input is an implementation choice.
Metadata preservation: getDomainState() preserves gameplayImplemented: false.
